findings.message: distributionUrl points outside services.gradle.org: https://fake-gradle.example.com/dists/gradle-8.5-bin.zip — ./gradlew downloads and EXECUTES whatever is there, before any build logic is evaluated. A corporate mirror is legitimate; verify this one is.
no distributionSha256Sum — Gradle supports pinning the distribution hash and this wrapper does not, so a substituted download would not be detected by Gradle itself
